name: submit_hero_picks
description: Save Tonight's pick: 3–9 titles, strongest first, each with a kicker and a reason. For You shows three a day from this list, so it should hold up over several days. The server checks the titles as it does a shelf's; a call replaces the picks saved before.

title.description: The title as TMDB names it: the server checks the id against it.

kicker.description: A short line above the title, at most 40 characters: A slow-burn mystery, From the makers of Dark.

reason.description: Why tonight, in one line of at most 140 characters, grounded in their profile.
